observations.text: CogEEGAgent's official repository explicitly separates artifact-only checks from recomputation. ARTIFACTS.md states that the canonical reproduction audit can run in --check-only mode from packaged workflow records without raw EEG; rebuilding ERP values requires source EEG, and reproducing semantic routing requires a model endpoint.

The public canonical manifest uses an exact allowlist and SHA-256 pins each selected scores.json/summary.json/results.json artifact. It declares 332 canonical task-instances, of which 313 have workflow-auditable logs and 19 are scores-only/unobserved. It also explicitly lists excluded debug, legacy, scripted, cross-model and other noncanonical runs.

The canonical check-only audit script is deterministic over the frozen JSON package: it verifies manifest structure, expected task counts, per-artifact SHA-256, task-ID alignment, workflow presence, error-free allowlisted statistical calls, finite/schema-valid statistics and p-values, and internal consistency of significance fields. It does not recompute EEG statistics from raw data.

The stored faithfulness audit reports PASS and a bounded detector-level result: among 313 workflow-auditable task-instances, all 235 cached parser-positive binary significance flags co-occur with an error-free statistical return indicating significance (235/235). It also preserves three failed-stat tasks, two no-stat tasks, 19 scores-only unobserved tasks and 12 effect_direction_ok=False task-instances rather than collapsing them into success.

The package is unusually explicit about what the static audit does not prove: co-occurrence does not establish that the statistical return matches the conclusion's contrast, channel, window, direction, p value, test statistic or effect size; the claim denominator is a cached parser field rather than fresh semantic adjudication. This is a direct implementation of observation/inference/uncertainty separation.

For Phase-1, this materially narrows replay dependency: a large execution-grounding audit can be reproduced from pinned stored artifacts without raw EEG or model routing. However the demonstrated replay still invokes a Python audit program over many files, and the audit deliberately stops short of semantic claim-to-result alignment. Under the current strict zero-richer-execution interpretation, it is a near-candidate component rather than an accepted end-to-end scheduled-Chat parity route.

protocol_inferences.name: REPLAY_PACKAGE_SHOULD_SEPARATE_STATIC_AUDIT_FROM_SCIENTIFIC_RECOMPUTATION
protocol_inferences.text: Publish a frozen artifact layer whose integrity, workflow structure and typed result consistency can be audited without raw scientific data or model access; separately declare which stronger claims require recomputation.

protocol_inferences.name: ALLOWLIST_AND_HASH_PIN_THE_REPLAY_DENOMINATOR
protocol_inferences.text: Replay denominators must be exact allowlists with per-artifact digests and explicit exclusions so debug/intermediate runs cannot silently enter or leave reported coverage.

protocol_inferences.name: UNOBSERVED_AND_FAILED_CASES_REMAIN_FIRST_CLASS
protocol_inferences.text: A replay package should preserve unobserved, no-call and failed-execution cases as named states rather than imputing success from retained scores or aggregate output.

protocol_inferences.name: EXECUTION_GROUNDING_IS_NOT_SEMANTIC_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT
protocol_inferences.text: A claim can be grounded to a successful statistical return at workflow level while still lacking verified contrast/window/direction/value alignment. These assurance levels must be represented separately.

phase1_acceptance.reason: The public package removes raw-EEG and model dependencies for its bounded check-only audit, but full independent replay is demonstrated through a Python audit program and the result is intentionally detector-level rather than semantic claim alignment. It therefore does not yet prove the complete useful outcome under the strict zero-richer-execution scheduled-Chat acceptance rule.
phase1_acceptance.near_candidate: Pinned JSON evidence package + exact allowlist + deterministic static predicates + explicit unobserved/failure states

scope_notes: Do not describe the 235/235 result as full scientific correctness or claim-value correctness.
Do not include the 19 scores-only tasks in workflow execution-grounding coverage.
Do not imply raw EEG is publicly redistributed; ARTIFACTS.md says it is not.
Do not infer the public repository main tree is the exact paper-evaluation revision unless separately bound.
